steps.c: Lay the A4 sheet flat, short edge facing you
Fold in half lengthways, crease, then unfold
Fold both top corners in to the centre crease
Fold the new slanted edges in to the centre crease
Fold in half along the centre crease, folds outside
Fold each wing down to the base, turning over between
